description: This Java source file defines a class FaultyMessageMapper that implements the MessageMapper interface and extends AbstractMessageMapper. The class is intended for testing purposes, as its map methods always throw an IllegalStateException, indicating a failure in message mapping. It is part of a messaging/connectivity service for Eclipse Ditto.

classes.name: FaultyMessageMapper
classes.description: A message mapper implementation that always throws exceptions during mapping, used for testing failure scenarios.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the message mapper with provided configuration; implementation ignores input.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage message)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects; here it always throws IllegalStateException.

methods.name: map (Adaptable adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessage; here it always throws IllegalStateException.
